## Checklist

- [ ] A changeset describes the change for users (`npx changeset`), or the change is not user-visible
- [ ] Docs pages are added or updated for anything users can see, and captures are regenerated
      (`npm --prefix docs run capture`, `npm --prefix docs run cli-reference`) when output changed
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
